info.parent: I Need to Find My Daughter

descriptions.notStarted: I wonder how Bruce is doing in Henesys these days...
descriptions.inProgress: I met up with Bruce in Henesys, and he had great news: He finally found his daughter!!! There was one problem, however: She seems to be suffering from amnesia, Bruce gave me a toy that his daughter played around while growing up, and asked me if I can give that to her.
descriptions.completed: I found Ayan and gave her the toy sword.
